# SMR Car Travels

> Premier 24/7 Car Rental, Taxi Service & Outstation Cabs in Anantapur (ATP Travels) managed by Founder Mohammad Rafi.

SMR Car Travels provides reliable, sanitized, and punctual chauffeur-driven car rental services headquartered in Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh. We specialize in local city rides, outstation roundtrips, one-way drops, and Bangalore Airport (KIA) transfers.

## Core Services
- [Outstation Cabs](https://smrcartravels.in/#routes): Dedicated intercity car rental from Anantapur to Bangalore, Hyderabad, Tirupati, Kurnool, and Kadapa.
- [Airport Transfers](https://smrcartravels.in/#routes): 24/7 flight-synchronized pickup and drops to Bangalore Kempegowda International Airport (KIA) and Hyderabad (RGIA).
- [Vehicle Fleet](https://smrcartravels.in/#fleet): Toyota Innova Crysta (7-Seater Luxury SUV), Suzuki Ertiga (7-Seater), Swift Dzire, Toyota Etios, Force Toofan (10-Seater), Force Tempo Traveller (12-17 Seater), and Minibus (20+ Seater).
- [Local Rentals](https://smrcartravels.in/#services): Flexible hourly and daily rental packages in Anantapur city limits.
- [Location & Google Maps](https://smrcartravels.in/#location): SMR Car Travels Head Office, Main Road, Transport Hub, Clock Tower Area, Anantapur, AP - 515001.
